title: A note of only spaces records no note
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919), a role that has 'Part Library & Inventory → View', 'Create & Edit' and 'Delete'.
  • Inventory part {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-SPACES-01) is tracked at {Location-A} and is active.
custom_steps:
1. Open {Part-A}, pick "Inactive" and click Save.
  2. Type five spaces in the note field.
  3. Click "Deactivate".
  4. Open {Part-A}'s Part History.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 3: The change is accepted and {Part-A} moves to the Inactive tab.
  • Step 4: The newest entry reads "Deactivated" and nothing more (no "| Reason:").

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10823 (Story 10, Confirming and Recording a Status Change); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v29 (14 Oct 2026 copy), S10-R15, S10-R17, read 14 Oct 2026; design canvas board 3.3 (Save asks first), 13 Oct copy. Tech plan "Parts Lifecycle Update — Technical Implementation Plan", 7 Oct 2026 (informs, never overrules), §5 New endpoints. Source-verified 14 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S10-R15: “Leaving the note empty, or entering only spaces, is allowed and records no note.”
  • S10-R17: “The entry reads "Deactivated" or "Activated". When the user gave a note it reads "Deactivated | Reason: {note}" or "Activated | Reason: {note}". With no note it reads "Deactivated" or "Activated" and nothing more.”
  • Tech plan (Parts Lifecycle Update, 7 Oct 2026), §5 New endpoints: “An empty or whitespace-only note is stored as null (S10-R15).”
